title: Indian Healing Clay: Aztec Secret (Bentonite Clay)
text: Health and Beauty Aztec Secret, Indian Healing Clay did exactly what I expected per the reviews read prior to the purchase. Of most concern to me was potential allergies and nourishment to the skin to which I'd be working.  So it was imperative for me to find a recipe besides one provide on the container to match the skin type and results expected and provide other holistic and healing therapeutic effects while keeping the mask stiff but not too rigid. There are many alternate recipes that can help match the skin type and bring more nutrition and nourishment to the skin while not allowing it to soften or harden up much more.  Research the skin type and wanted effects and match it up to the recipe of your choice that would compliment the skin with which you are working. What I saw was a more smooth, clean and lighter tone to the skin and yes it did get rid of blackheads over the nose and even lightened up a tash or scar...besides providing a more smooth and youthful appearance to the tone of the olive skin (light cinnamon) to which it was applied. I would definitely recommend the Aztec Clay to anyone looking for a more youthful appearance, tighter skin and would like to get rid of black heads over the nose and lighten up scars which can take away from your precense.
